CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_chat_media_060(p_actor_id uuid, p_choir_id uuid, p_file_version_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(
    select 1 from public.chat_media_versions v
    join public.choir_members actor on actor.auth_user_id=p_actor_id and actor.choir_id=v.choir_id and actor.is_active
    join public.chat_room_members rm on rm.room_id=v.room_id and rm.choir_id=v.choir_id and rm.member_id=actor.id
    where v.id=p_file_version_id and v.choir_id=p_choir_id and v.state='active' and (
      (v.kind='room-avatar' and exists(select 1 from public.chat_rooms r
        where r.id=v.room_id and r.avatar_media_version_id=v.id))
      or (v.kind='message-image' and exists(select 1 from public.chat_messages m
        where m.id=v.message_id and m.room_id=v.room_id and not m.is_deleted
          and (m.metadata_json->'private_media_version_ids') ? v.id::text))
    )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_choir_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with request_context as (
    select
      (select auth.uid()) as auth_user_id,
      genova_005.current_session_id() as session_id
  ),
  selected_membership as (
    select active.choir_id
    from request_context context
    join genova_005.active_choir_sessions active
      on active.session_id = context.session_id
     and active.auth_user_id = context.auth_user_id
    join public.choir_members member
      on member.choir_id = active.choir_id
     and member.auth_user_id = active.auth_user_id
    limit 1
  ),
  only_membership as (
    select
      case when count(*) = 1 then (array_agg(member.choir_id))[1] end as choir_id
    from public.choir_members member
    where member.auth_user_id = (select auth_user_id from request_context)
  )
  select coalesce(
    (select choir_id from selected_membership),
    (select choir_id from only_membership)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_choir_member_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select member.id
  from public.choir_members member
  where member.auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and member.choir_id = public.current_choir_id()
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_member_has_role(role_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.choir_member_roles member_role
    join public.roles role on role.id = member_role.role_id
    where member_role.member_id = public.current_choir_member_id()
      and member_role.choir_id = public.current_choir_id()
      and role.choir_id = member_role.choir_id
      and (
        role.name = role_name
        or (
          role_name in ('Şef', 'Åef', 'Sef')
          and role.name in ('Şef', 'Åef', 'Sef')
        )
        or (
          role_name in ('Partisyon Şefi', 'Partisyon Åefi', 'Partisyon Sefi')
          and role.name in ('Partisyon Şefi', 'Partisyon Åefi', 'Partisyon Sefi')
        )
      )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_member_voice_group()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select member.voice_group
  from public.choir_members member
  where member.id = public.current_choir_member_id()
    and member.choir_id = public.current_choir_id()
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION genova_005.current_session_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when coalesce((select auth.jwt()->>'session_id'), '') ~*
      '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    then ((select auth.jwt()->>'session_id'))::uuid
    else null
  end;
$function$

begin transaction read only;
select
  current_setting('server_version') as server_version,
  to_regnamespace('genova_078')::text as schema078,
  to_regnamespace('genova_090')::text as schema090,
  to_regclass('auth.sessions')::text as auth_sessions,
  to_regclass('genova_005.active_choir_sessions')::text as active_sessions,
  to_regprocedure('genova_005.current_session_id()')::text as session_helper,
  to_regclass('public.assignment_submission_file_versions')::text as assignment_versions,
  to_regclass('public.assignment_review_audio_versions')::text as review_versions,
  to_regclass('public.repertoire_comment_audio_versions')::text as comment_versions,
  to_regprocedure('public.can_read_chat_media_060(uuid,uuid,uuid)')::text as chat_read,
  to_regprocedure('public.private_file_ticket_authorized_090(uuid,uuid,uuid,text,uuid)')::text as authority090,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,
    'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,
    'config',p.proconfig,'acl',p.proacl::text,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),
    'anon_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
    'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),
    'service_execute',has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) order by p.proname)
    from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace
    where (n.nspname='public' and p.proname in
      ('current_choir_id','current_choir_member_id','set_active_choir',
       'current_member_has_role','current_member_voice_group','can_read_chat_media_060',
       'private_file_ticket_authorized_090'))
      or (n.nspname='genova_005' and p.proname='current_session_id')) as helpers;
rollback;

begin transaction read only;
select
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,
    'kind',c.relkind,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'options',c.reloptions,
    'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force_rls',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',c.relacl::text,
    'anon_select',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT'),
    'anon_insert',has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'INSERT'),
    'authenticated_select',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT'),
    'authenticated_insert',has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'INSERT'),
    'definition',case when c.relkind='v' then pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) else null end)
    order by c.relname)
    from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
    where n.nspname='public' and c.relname in
      ('public_choir_members','choir_members','contact_messages','newsletter_subscribers','subscribers','collab_inquiries')) as sibling_relations,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',schemaname||'.'||tablename,
    'name',policyname,'permissive',permissive,'roles',roles,'cmd',cmd,
    'using',qual,'check',with_check) order by tablename,policyname)
    from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename in
      ('choir_members','contact_messages','newsletter_subscribers','subscribers','collab_inquiries')) as sibling_policies,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',rolname,'superuser',rolsuper,
    'inherit',rolinherit,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls,'can_login',rolcanlogin) order by rolname)
    from pg_roles where rolname in ('postgres','anon','authenticated','service_role')) as role_attributes,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',o.oprname,
    'left',format_type(o.oprleft,null),'right',format_type(o.oprright,null))
    order by n.nspname,o.oprname)
    from pg_operator o join pg_namespace n on n.oid=o.oprnamespace
    where n.nspname not in ('pg_catalog','information_schema')) as custom_operators,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(n.nspowner),'acl',n.nspacl::text))
    from pg_namespace n where n.nspname in ('genova_005','genova_078','genova_090')) as authority_schemas,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('column',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull) order by a.attnum)
    from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid='genova_005.active_choir_sessions'::regclass and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped) as active_session_columns;
rollback;
queries.Prereq:
begin transaction read only;
select
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'relation',c.relname,'kind',c.relkind,
   'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'acl',c.relacl::text,
   'columns',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)) order by a.attnum)
     from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid=c.oid and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped))
   order by n.nspname,c.relname)
   from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace
   where (n.nspname='public' and c.relname in ('choir_members','roles','choir_member_roles','repertoire_files','song_assignments','repertoire',
     'assignment_submission_file_versions','assignment_review_audio_versions','repertoire_comment_audio_versions','assignment_submissions',
     'assignment_submission_history','repertoire_song_comments','chat_media_versions','chat_room_members','chat_rooms','chat_messages'))
     or (n.nspname='auth' and c.relname='sessions')
     or (n.nspname='genova_005' and c.relname='active_choir_sessions')) as required_relations,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',case when d.classid='pg_proc'::regclass then 'function' when d.classid='pg_policy'::regclass then 'policy' when d.classid='pg_rewrite'::regclass then 'rewrite' else d.classid::regclass::text end,
   'object',pg_describe_object(d.classid,d.objid,d.objsubid),
   'depends_on',d.refobjid::regprocedure::text) order by d.classid,d.objid)
   from pg_depend d where d.refclassid='pg_proc'::regclass and d.refobjid in
      ('public.current_choir_id()'::regprocedure,'public.current_choir_member_id()'::regprocedure,
       'public.set_active_choir(uuid)'::regprocedure)) as tracked_helper_dependencies,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',schemaname||'.'||tablename,'policy',policyname,'command',cmd,'roles',roles,'permissive',permissive,'using',qual,'check',with_check)
   order by tablename,policyname) from pg_policies where
    coalesce(qual,'')||' '||coalesce(with_check,'') ~ '(current_choir_id|current_choir_member_id|current_member_has_role|current_member_voice_group)') as helper_policy_references;
rollback;
queries.Constraints: begin read only; select n.nspname as schema,c.relname as relation,k.conname as name,k.contype as type,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) as definition from pg_constraint k join pg_class c on c.oid=k.conrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where (n.nspname='genova_005' and c.relname='active_choir_sessions') or (n.nspname='auth' and c.relname='sessions') order by n.nspname,c.relname,k.conname; rollback;
